subject: Sporting Legends Daily/Weekly timed jackpot schedule

historicalPrimaryProviderEvidence.dailyTextMeaning: Jackpots won before 9pm restart; after 9pm the next day's jackpot begins.
historicalPrimaryProviderEvidence.weeklyTextMeaning: Weekly jackpot runs until midnight every Friday and restarts after that time.

historicalApMcCoyProviderEvidence.dailyTextMeaning: If Daily is won before 9pm it retriggers.
historicalApMcCoyProviderEvidence.weeklyTextMeaning: Weekly runs until midnight every Friday.

currentBetfairSpainEvidence.dailyRule: If the current Daily is won before 9:00 p.m. GMT/BST, one or more additional jackpots may activate within remaining Daily ticker time.
currentBetfairSpainEvidence.weeklyRule: If the current Weekly is won before 12:00 p.m. GMT/BST on Saturday, one or more additional jackpots may become available during remaining Weekly ticker time.
currentBetfairSpainEvidence.noGameplayRule: If no game is played at the moment a Daily or Weekly should be won, that jackpot is triggered by the first bet placed the following day.
